title: Remove Linked List Elements
description: Remove all nodes from a linked list that have a specific value.

data.text: Given `head` and an integer `val`, remove all nodes whose `Val` equals `val` and return the new head.

data.title: Rebuild O(n) O(n)
Relink O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: Rebuilding the list allocates a new node for every kept element. The dummy node technique handles head removals uniformly by pretending there is a node before the real head. The previous pointer simply skips nodes that match the target value, relinking the list in place with no new allocations.

cards.title: Rebuild List
cards.description: Build a fresh list excluding target values

cards.title: Dummy Node + Relink
cards.description: Skip matching nodes by rewiring Next pointers
